629:t_022:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The $$ダブルオーライザー$$ has shut down its functions and is drifting away!」

629:t_022:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Send someone to recover it!」

629:t_022:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I leave the rest... to you...」

629:t_023:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Damn it! How dare you do that to $$刹那$$ and $$ティエリア$$!」

629:t_023:3.en:
$$シン$$
「$$刹那$$ was trying to talk with you! And yet...!」

629:t_023:6.en:
$$スザク$$
「If we fall back here, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ will reach Earth...!」

629:t_023:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「But any more fighting is impossible...」

629:t_023:8.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! In the region farther behind us, I'm detecting a massive gravity tremor!」

629:t_023:9.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Judging from the surrounding conditions, I believe the main body of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ has arrived!」

629:t_023:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So the full-scale invasion finally begins...」

629:t_023:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We have to deal with that as well. All units, fall back to the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ for now.」

629:t_023:12.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「This is an order from your commander! I won't allow any refusal!」

629:t_023:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Is pulling back... all we can do...?」

629:t_024:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「What you opened wasn't $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

629:t_024:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That was what's called Pandora's Box. That's why despair burst out of it.」

629:t_024:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But at the bottom of it lies hope...」

629:t_025:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Even if we keep shooting them down one after another, it doesn't feel like it'll ever end!」

629:t_025:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Fight, Darling! We've got no choice but to do it!」

629:t_025:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But if we keep fighting like this, we'll hit our limit someday...」

629:t_100:0.en:
$$刹那$$
(This sensation I feel from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...)

629:t_100:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$刹那$$... I know what you're thinking.」

629:t_100:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Don't be bound by common sense or preconceptions. Just do what you feel.」

629:t_100:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That is your duty, and supporting you in it is mine.」

629:t_100:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「First, we make contact with as many $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ as we can! Let's go!」

629:t_101:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
(This chaotic sensation... can it be called a will...?)

629:t_102:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(What do they want to do...? This sensation... seems a little different from hostility...)

629:t_102:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(What should I do...!? Is there nothing we can do besides fight...!?)

629:t_103:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Every time I make contact with them, feedback comes to me from the $$サイコ・フレーム$$...)

629:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
(The $$ユニコーン$$ is trying to tell me something... Is that... the will of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...?)

629:t_104:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Have my senses sharpened!? I can feel something from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$!」

629:t_105:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Hostile life forms approaching.」

629:t_105:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Unable to answer. ...This unit is not under the control of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

629:t_105:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Therefore, identification of the target as friend or foe is entrusted to the organization Ensign $$レド$$ belongs to... that is, to Ensign $$レド$$ himself.」

629:t_105:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Meaningful advice. The danger posed by the target's existence is a fact. It is recommended that you first give priority to your own safety.」

629:t_105:7.en:
$$レド$$
「In the end... fighting is all we can do...」

629:t_106:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Setting a new action objective. This unit will analyze the true nature and purpose of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ as far as possible, as material for future strategic decisions.」

629:t_106:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Acknowledged. Supporting $$刹那$$'s unit, which plays an extremely important role in understanding the target, is recommended.」

629:t_106:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Got it! As long as he doesn't give up, we'll back him up!」

629:t_107:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$... If you two believe in songs, then I believe in you.)

629:t_107:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(I know you'll come through...! So I'll protect you both!)

629:t_108:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Did you know? Aimo is a love song.」

629:t_108:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Now, let's do our best! To protect this song, too!」

uncertain: Aimo (アイモ) is a song title, not in glossary; written as plain 'Aimo'.
t_023:13 Hibiki's thought is about Setsuna and Tieria; Setsuna/Tieria tokens used.
t_106:0 speaker is Ledo but the speech is Chamber-style formal; kept formal.
t_023:0/t_022:3 Tieria's 'Erde' written with the token $$アーデ$$ (Mileina calling him by family name).
